remedies.name: Salt Water Gargle
remedies.description: Mix 1/2 teaspoon of salt in warm water and gargle for 30 seconds. Helps reduce inflammation and kill bacteria.

remedies.name: Honey & Ginger Tea
remedies.description: Ginger has anti-inflammatory properties, and honey soothes the throat.

warning: If accompanied by high fever or difficulty breathing, consult a doctor immediately.

remedies.name: Steam Inhalation
remedies.description: Inhale steam from a bowl of hot water to clear nasal passages.

remedies.name: Turmeric Milk (Haldi Doodh)
remedies.description: Traditional immunity booster with anti-inflammatory properties.

warning: Steam can cause burns; be careful. Not for very young children.

remedies.name: Honey & Black Pepper
remedies.description: Lick a spoon of honey with a pinch of black pepper.

warning: Persistent cough > 2 weeks requires TB screening.
